name: Splashell
notes: Splashell: a sky-blue sea slug carrying a teal spiral shell, with two round-tipped eye stalks. Type WATER. Moves: Water Gun (A), Bubble Beam (B) and Surf (R). Walks at only 50 % speed (the slowest of all), but heals 2 HP every second (regen) up to its max, as the player, a wild monster or the Alpha, in every mode. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: SPLASHELL
